target_customer: City governments and transportation agencies that run traffic signals
problem: Most city traffic lights run fixed timing plans; XTraffic uses sensor data to predict demand and control signals in real time on existing infrastructure.
business_model: B2B2G software and sensor pilots sold to cities (pricing not stated)

founders.name: Everett Ivy
prior_employers: Amazon (control systems and robotics, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Former professional gamer per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time control of safety-critical signals using sensor and detector data needs reliability and integration with legacy controllers; founders have control and robotics experience.

defensibility.rationale: Government contracts, pilots and integration with city infrastructure create stickiness; no patents or exclusive data were found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent action; not established.

market_need_then: Texas cities were adopting AI traffic tools to reduce crashes in 2024 per Dallas Morning News and Planetizen coverage found in search results; not opened.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; descriptive name for a government buyer.
